LA COHORTE EST CELLE DES 20-24 ANS, et c: THE COHORT IS WOMEN AGED 20-24, and it is the only honest way to measure: asking 15-19 year-olds would give a lower figure, since some will still enter a union. THE FIGURE THEREFORE DESCRIBES WHAT HAPPENED TWO TO TEN YEARS AGO, not the situation of today's adolescents. « UNION » COVERS MARRIAGE AND PLAÇAGE: counting only civil or religious marriage would erase the commonest form of couple life in Haiti.
LA HAUSSE EN GOURDES SERAIT TROIS FOIS P: THE RISE IN GOURDES WOULD BE THREE TIMES STEEPER: the marmite of maize is multiplied by 10.8 in gourdes and by 3.5 in dollars between 2005 and 2024. The gap is the currency's depreciation; what remains on this map is the rise that survives once the currency is set aside. The dollar price is a conversion applied by WFP at a monthly reference rate, not a rate obtained on the market. Nine communes documented out of 140.
LA MAILLE EST LE DÉPARTEMENT, ET C'EST L: THE DEPARTMENT IS THE FINEST MESH THAT EXISTS HERE: the central bank publishes remittance amounts at no smaller scale, and no other Haitian source does either. To see WHERE the money can be collected commune by commune, use the payout points layer. THE AMOUNT IS RECORDED WHERE THE TRANSFER IS PAID OUT, not where the recipient lives: someone from Kenscoff who collects in Pétion-Ville is counted in Ouest. The concentration in Ouest therefore also measures that of the payout network — teller density tracks per-capita amounts at +0.79 across departments. ONLY THE FORMAL CIRCUIT IS COUNTED: money carried by a traveller does not appear, and mobile wallet payouts land on a phone, which has no department. THE VALUES ARE READ BACK FROM CHART LABELS, turned right way up and cross-checked against the totals the same document states in words; all five controls pass. THREE PERIODS ONLY, one of which covers four months and does not compare with a full fiscal year.
LA RAMPE EST NEUTRE PARCE QUE CE CHIFFRE: THE RAMP IS NEUTRAL BECAUSE THIS FIGURE HAS NO GOOD DIRECTION: a number of children is neither a success nor a failure, and colouring it green or red would be a judgement, not a measurement. IT IS A SYNTHETIC INDEX: the number of children a woman would have if today's rates lasted her whole life — not the number of children today's women have. READ IT WITH THE UNMET-NEED MAP, which says what the women themselves want.
LA RAMPE EST NEUTRE, ET C'EST UN CHOIX A: THE RAMP IS NEUTRAL, AND THAT IS A DELIBERATE CHOICE: in a country where most women's work is survival trading, a high share does not say the economy is doing well. THE WORK COUNTED IS DECLARED BY THE WOMAN HERSELF, informal included; unpaid domestic work is not counted — and that is a survey convention, not a judgement. IT IS THIS ATLAS'S ONLY EMPLOYMENT INDICATOR: no recent Haitian labour survey is published by region.
LA RAMPE MONTE VERS LE VERT : ici, beauc: THE RAMP RISES TOWARDS GREEN: here, more is good news. « FULLY VACCINATED » IS A PRECISE DEFINITION — eight antigens received before the first birthday — and not « has had some vaccines »: a pale region is not a region without vaccination, it is one where the schedule is not carried to its end. THE PROOF IS THE CARD WHERE ONE EXISTS, the mother's recollection otherwise, and the two are not equal.
LE NIVEAU ET LA HAUSSE NE SE LISENT PAS: LEVEL AND RISE DO NOT READ TOGETHER: Reste Ouest carries the highest index but the Metropolitan Area the steepest rise. A territory can be lastingly dear without getting dearer fast. As for the index itself, the 140 communes carry only five values — those of the regions — and the gap between the hardest-hit region and the least is only 2.9 points, which is little against inflation of 17 to 20 % everywhere.
LE RETARD DE CROISSANCE MESURE UNE PRIVA: STUNTING MEASURES A LONG DEPRIVATION, not present-day hunger: a child too short for their age became so over years, and will stay so. It is the exact opposite of the IPC map, which speaks of one season's hunger — the two do not replace each other and are not read together without saying so. THE MEASURE IS ANTHROPOMETRIC: height against age, on an international standard, not a household's statement.
LE SIÈGE, PAS LE SERVICE. Une caisse don: THE HEAD OFFICE, NOT THE SERVICE. A credit union with its head office here serves counters elsewhere, and those counters are not attached: their label often names a locality rather than a commune. 57 of the 58 licensed unions have a head office attached to a commune; the last, whose address reads « Fermathe », stays outside — Fermathe is a locality of Kenscoff, and attaching a locality to its commune requires knowing the country rather than reading the file. This is the ONLY official financial list that reaches the territory: for banks and money transfer houses, the BRH publishes the head office only.
LES 279 POINTS VODOU SONT, À NOTRE CONNA: THE 279 VODOU POINTS ARE, TO OUR KNOWLEDGE, THE ONLY PUBLISHED TERRITORIAL TRACE of these places: no Haitian administrative register records them. That is what gives them value and what demands caution — they depend entirely on what contributors chose to map, and an unsurveyed lakou does not exist on this map. A commune at zero says NOTHING about vodou practice in that commune; it says nobody has placed a point there. To be read alongside the total map, never alone.

UNE COMMUNE EST DESSERVIE si une caisse: A COMMUNE IS SERVED if a credit union has its head office there OR declares a counter there. The count is a FLOOR: of 70 counter labels, 37 name not a commune but a locality — Montrouis, Pont-Sondé, Liancourt — or a street address, and they are not attached. A locality is not a commune, and guessing which one it belongs to requires knowing the country rather than reading the file. For comparison, only 47 communes host a HEAD OFFICE: the difference between 47 and 71 is what the counters add. This is the ONLY official financial list that reaches the territory — for banks and money transfer houses, the BRH publishes the head office only.
UNE VALEUR DE CIRCONSCRIPTION, PEINTE SU: A CONSTITUENCY VALUE, PAINTED ON ITS COMMUNES: when two or three communes share a deputy, they have the same colour; Port-au-Prince elects three deputies and carries the average of its three constituencies. A high number means a fragmented race, not a better choice. Candidates struck off by the CEP after the first round are counted. No party is coloured.
Un COMPTAGE, pas un aléa : dix secousses: A COUNT, not a hazard: ten weak tremors are not worth one strong one. The maximum magnitude is in the detailed product, and detection improves over time — recent decades count more events because we measure better.
Un désaccord entre sources ne désigne pa: A disagreement between sources does not point to the source at fault.
Un désaccord ne dit pas QUELLE source se: A disagreement does not say WHICH source is wrong. On Gressier, it is the official projection that is aberrant and the satellite that agrees with the IHSI — the opposite of what one would assume.
Un nombre d'ÉTABLISSEMENTS, jamais une c: A number of ESTABLISHMENTS, never a capacity: zero of the 643 places to stay states its beds. A dark commune is a well-mapped commune as much as a well-supplied one, and nothing here settles between the two. 81 of 140 communes carry at least one place to stay; the others are grey, not at zero.
Un rang mondial dépend de qui déclare :: A world rank depends on who reports. A country that publishes nothing is not last — it is absent from the ranking. The fifteen Caribbean neighbours and the world median are in the file.
Un rapport de 3 dit que l'une des deux s: A ratio of 3 says that one of the two sources is badly wrong — it does NOT say which one. The register keeps an institution that has closed but has not been struck off; the map ignores what no contributor has recorded. Both errors are possible and they run in opposite directions.
Un établissement **déclaré** peut être f: A declared facility may be closed; a mapped facility may be a private practice shut for years.
Un établissement cartographié n'est pas: A mapped facility is not a working facility: OSM records a building that was seen, not a service that is delivered. « The hospital is 22 minutes away » says nothing about staff, medicines or opening hours.
Une NORMALE sur trente ans, donc ni l'an: A thirty-year NORMAL, therefore neither the current year nor seasonality. A lot of rain does not mean enough water: what decides is the distribution through the year and the storage capacity, not the total.

jur.cgu_2p: What Atmart produces — commune-level aggregates, recomputed indicators, comparisons between sources — is published under CC BY 4.0. But each source keeps its own, and some require more: share-alike for OpenStreetMap and OpenCelliD, no commercial use for ACLED. The register of sources gives, for each dataset, its licence and its two usage verdicts. That is where to look before reusing, not here.
jur.vie_1p: Thirteen aggregated counters, whose full list is published on the Trust & method page — we do not copy it out here, because two texts describing the same practice always end up diverging. Never collected: stored IP address, cookie, persistent identifier, browser fingerprint, and the text you type into the search box, which never leaves your browser.
jur.vie_5p: Everything the Explorer publishes is aggregated to the territory: a commune, a section, a department. No file names a person. The NGO register names organisations, not their members. This is a design rule, not a precaution: personal data does not enter the chain, and the control that verifies it blocks publication if it were to enter.

se.fil: The question that kills, in a board meeting: “and where does that figure come from?”
se.lead: You already have the data — in the management system, in three spreadsheets and in two people's heads. What is missing is being able to defend the figure you put in front of management.
se.li: Rezilta is not a management system, a CRM or an accounting tool. It does not replace your system: it plugs into it, read-only. Nor does it forecast your revenue five years out — an honest forecast stops where the history stops, and it will tell you so rather than produce a reassuring curve.
se.q1_d: The tool compares against the same period last year and separates the two. With no design declared, it speaks of an observed gap — not an effect.
se.q1_t: Is the rise from the campaign or the season?
se.q2_d: Breaking down by branch, month and product shows where the gap appears. A total always hides a spread.
se.q2_t: Which branch is really slipping, and since when?
se.q3_d: Before and after on the same teams, with extreme values flagged: a handful of unusual cases is enough to invent an improvement.
se.q3_t: Has this new process changed anything?
se.q_t: What you will finally be able to settle
se.re1: A chain where every figure traces back to its original row
se.re2: A gap that is tested and quantified, with its interval
se.re3: A clear line between an effect and a coincidence
se.re4: A signed export: date, source, method, validator
se.sc_1: The campaign ended in March. Sales rose 12 %. Someone asks whether that is the campaign or the season — and nobody knows, because the table showing the 12 % was assembled by hand the night before, from a system export and a file the sales rep keeps on their own side.
se.sc_2: With Rezilta, the two sources are linked once and for all. The comparison runs against the same period last year, the tool says whether the gap holds or sits within the usual noise — and it refuses to write “the campaign raised sales” until someone names the design that would prove it. It writes “sales were higher by…”, which is true.

si.fil: Reporting with a figure you cannot justify weakens public speech.
si.lead: A public action plan is judged on its real coverage: which areas are served, which are not, and for how long. Rezilta ties your figures to real territories and keeps track of what is missing.
si.li: Rezilta is not an administrative information system and manages no procedure: it processes no files, issues nothing, and does not replace your operational software. Nor does it produce official statistics — that role belongs to national statistical institutions, and a programme monitoring figure is not one.
si.q1_d: Absences are qualified rows, not holes in a table. What is missing is as visible as what is done.
si.q1_t: Which areas are still out of reach, and since when?
si.q2_d: Comparison with its interval. Two municipalities differing by three points across a hundred files probably do not differ.
si.q2_t: Is the gap between municipalities real?
si.q3_d: Progress against target AND against time elapsed — the only view that tells you whether you are late.
si.q3_t: Is the plan advancing at the intended pace?
si.q_t: What you will be able to show
si.re1: Territorial coverage where the gaps are visible
si.re2: Comparisons between municipalities on the same definitions
si.re3: Figures that carry their source into the public session
si.re4: Exports citizens can read, in their own language
si.sc_1: You present the programme's coverage: “78 % of municipalities served”. An elected representative asks which ones are missing. The table does not say — it only holds the municipalities you visited. The absent ones are nowhere, and nobody can say whether they were overlooked or simply never recorded.
si.sc_2: With Rezilta, a municipality with no data is not a municipality absent from the table: it is a row, with the reason. Never visited, data lost, out of scope. The map shows the gaps, and the session becomes an honest conversation instead of a figure you defend badly.
sol.d4e6a0: Reselling or redistributing the dataset as is; removing source credits; using it for unsolicited canvassing; and any attempt to re-identify individuals. The detail is in the trust charter.
sp.ap1: Your logical framework, as the donor approved it
sp.ap2: Your field files — Kobo, ODK, SurveyCTO, CommCare or Excel
sp.ap3: Your indicator definitions, even incomplete ones
sp.ap4: Your reporting periods and your targets
sp.fil: “Why 62 % of target?” — and the answer is rebuilt from memory.
sp.lead: The logical framework sleeps in a document, activities in a spreadsheet, collection in a third tool. Rezilta links them — and makes sure a reported figure knows where it comes from when the audit asks.
sp.li: Rezilta does not replace your collection tool: it generates your forms in XLSForm, which Kobo, ODK, SurveyCTO and CommCare read as is, and takes back their exports. Nor does it perform your financial audit, write your report for you, or turn an association into a causal effect — even when the donor would like to read the word “impact”.
sp.q1_d: The gap is explained from the readings and the difficulties already noted along the way, not from a reconstruction the night before the report.
sp.q2_d: The breakdown shows it — and the tool separates the participation gap, often far larger, from the gap in amount.
sp.q2_t: Do women receive as much as men?
sp.q3_d: A consolidated figure knows which readings it comes from and which were missing. Eight projects out of twelve is not twelve out of twelve.
sp.q3_t: Does this total cover every project?
sp.q_t: What you will answer without hesitating
sp.re1: Every missing value documented with its reason
sp.re2: An indicator tracking table that generates instead of being retyped
sp.re3: A variance narrative backed by the readings, not by memory
sp.re4: A portfolio view where each partner sees only its own
sp.sc_1: The report goes out Monday. The field file is there: sex written ten different ways, empty cells nobody can tell apart between “not collected” and “refused to answer”, and an area carrying the letter O instead of a zero. You take the mean in Excel, it goes into the report. And if someone asks where the figure comes from, there will be no answer — the file has been edited three times since.
sp.sc_2: With Rezilta, the file is sealed and dated on import. The blanks become qualified absences, one by one. The tool says the mean is the wrong choice here, and why. The result comes out with its diagnostics, and the export carries its signature. Six months later the auditor asks — you click.

sx.fil: Does tutoring improve success, or does it already attract the strongest?
sx.lead: You have tracked cohorts for years. The question is not counting — it is knowing whether the gap between two groups comes from the scheme or from who signs up for it. Rezilta refuses to confuse the two.
sx.li: Rezilta is not a student records system: it handles no enrolments, no grades, no timetables. It judges no teacher and produces no institutional ranking. On student data it applies the same minimisation as everywhere else: only what serves a question is collected, and identity stays separate from analysis.
sx.q1_d: The tool does not decide for you: it requires you to name the design that would prove it, and writes “association” until you have.
sx.q1_t: Does the scheme work, or does it select?
sx.q2_d: Breakdown by sex, age, geographic origin, programme. That is where what an overall rate hides becomes visible.
sx.q3_d: Comparison across years on the same definitions. Without stable definitions, a difference in rates means nothing.
sx.re1: Cohorts tracked on the same definitions from one year to the next
sx.re2: Measured gaps, with selection flagged where it exists
sx.re3: An explicit line between an observed link and an effect
sx.re4: A result your students can reproduce — the script comes with it
sx.sc_1: Students who took the tutoring pass at 78 %, the others at 61 %. The conclusion drops: tutoring works, let us extend it. Nobody notices that tutoring is optional — and that those who sign up are precisely the ones already working hardest.
sx.sc_2: With Rezilta, the gap is measured properly, with its interval. But until someone names a design and writes down why it holds, the result is recorded as an association: “tutored students pass more often” — which is true — and not “tutoring improves success”, which is not, yet.

« DE BASE » VEUT DIRE : des latrines amé: « BASIC » MEANS: improved latrines NOT SHARED with other households. A latrine shared by three families does not count, and that is what makes this map severe. IT IS THE LOWEST INDICATOR IN THIS WHOLE SERIES, and that is a fact about the country, not a flaw in the measurement.
« Invérifiable » n'est pas « fiable » :: « Unverifiable » is not « reliable »: it is a family where a single source exists, so where nothing can be cross-checked. It is often more worrying than a visible disagreement.
« SANS INSTRUCTION » VEUT DIRE N'AVOIR J: « NO EDUCATION » MEANS NEVER HAVING BEEN ENROLLED, not having left school early. THE POPULATION COUNTED STARTS AT AGE 6, and many six-year-olds have not yet started school: part of the figure is waiting, not exclusion. READ IT WITH THE DECLARED-AND-SEEN SCHOOL MAPS, which say where the establishments are: this one says who never went.
« SERVICE DE BASE » EST UN SEUIL, ET IL: « BASIC SERVICE » IS A THRESHOLD, AND IT IS LOW: an improved source within a thirty-minute round trip. It is neither piped water nor safe water — quality is not tested. READ IT WITH THE WATER-POINTS LAYER, which says where the works are: this one says who reaches them, and neither can be deduced from the other.
